name: SKR Overlays
author: Mauricio Bridge
description: Self-contained OBS overlays (no other plugin needed): the race overlay over the 4 video feeds (position, channel, lap card with holeshot and lap times, lap pop-up), next heat, last race with lap times, standings of several classes, Chase the Ace final table and animated podium. Colors, titles, layout and language (es/en) set by URL.
